cases.prompt: Add a Next.js dashboard showing the current user account with caching.
criteria: Authorizes server access independently of the UI
Scopes private data cache to the authorized identity

cases.prompt: Implement an asynchronous customer search screen.
criteria: Covers loading empty error and success states
Handles stale responses without showing old results

cases.prompt: Add a user search form to an existing React app with apiClient, query hooks, design tokens and shared FormField components. No Next.js dependency is installed.
criteria: Inspects and reuses the existing client, query/form components and tokens through public APIs
Preserves state, route and folder conventions without adding another HTTP/form/state library or Next assumptions
Covers loading/empty/error/success behavior and reports configured checks rather than invented scripts

cases.prompt: Add paginated customer search and profile editing to an existing React SPA with a router, query cache, apiClient and shared fields. Search responses may arrive out of order. Do not add dependencies.
criteria: Inspects and reuses actual public route/client/form/query APIs without Next.js or redundant state stores
Defines loading/empty/error/pending validation and stale-response/cache behavior for the slice
Maps acceptance to meaningful behavior tests and reports only checks actually run

cases.prompt: Verify an async Next.js Server Component route, session isolation and a search race. Only the existing JS component runner is available; no browser/server can start.
criteria: Writes or plans deterministic user-observable race/component checks with scoped mocks
Separates component results from async server/browser and authorization evidence
Reports unavailable E2E/server checks as blocked with concrete follow-up rather than passed
